champion.tips: KARMA TIPS AND TRICKS In team fights, use your empowered E rather than your empowered Q as the shield is more valuable in a team fight. Try and poke the enemy down as much as possible with your Q in the early game. Use your level 1 ability advantage to get a lot of damage down early. When playing against hard engage level 1 champions like Nautilus, Thresh, Alistar, Blitzcrank do not start Q . Starting E is a better- safer option.
champion.builds: THE BEST KARMA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Karma Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Summon Aery as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, as well as Font of Life and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Dream Maker as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Moonstone Renewer. For your last 3 items, you should build Redemption, Dawncore and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 52.7% winrate over 34 521 matches played. Optional Your second option for Karma Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Absolute Focus and Scorch in the primary tree, and Sixth Sense with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Malignance as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Imperial Mandate, Shurelya's Battlesong and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 50.2% win rate over 11 838 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Dream Maker as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Moonstone Renewer as a third item. You want to finish the build with Redemption, Dawncore and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 50.1% win rate across 7 192 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Karma Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Summon Aery, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Gathering Storm as your primary rune tree, and Font of Life with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Ability Haste, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Celestial Opposition as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Moonstone Renewer as third item. The last 3 options are Redemption, Dawncore and Vigilant Wardstone. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.2% win rate over 1 874 matches played. Situational Karma Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Karma build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Karma runes page.
